param.name: source_geodatabase
param.dialogReference: Required input. Select the existing ArcGIS Indoors file geodatabase (.gdb) to inspect. The tool reads this workspace only; it does not add fields, records, domains, or relationships to it. The geodatabase must contain Facilities, Levels, and Units feature classes, and Facilities and Units must have GlobalID fields. Units must contain USE_TYPE.

param.name: profile_json
param.dialogReference: Optional input. Select Hospital or Government Office from the dropdown to evaluate each distinct Units.USE_TYPE value against that bundled profile. The report identifies the resolved profile room use and flags values without an explicit mapping. Leave empty to inventory the geodatabase without evaluating profile coverage.

param.name: inspection_report
param.dialogReference: Required output. Specify the JSON file to create. The report includes the discovered feature classes and tables, field and GlobalID inventories, Units count, spatial reference, coded domains, relationship classes, possible oriented-imagery sources, and USE_TYPE mapping results when a profile is supplied. An existing source geodatabase is never changed.

dataIdInfo.idAbs: Inspects an existing ArcGIS Indoors file geodatabase and writes a read-only JSON implementation report. Use this tool before generating demo data to verify the minimum Indoors hierarchy, understand available schema elements, identify possible oriented imagery sources, and review Units.USE_TYPE compatibility with a selected facility profile.

descript.purpose: Provide a non-destructive compatibility and discovery report before the generated asset-management schema is created in a copied geodatabase.
